mean = sum of readings ÷ number of readi.name: mean
mean = sum of readings ÷ number of readi.description: Average: add the values and divide by how many there are, or use the stated probability weights.

u_mean = s ÷ √n.name: u_mean
u_mean = s ÷ √n.description: Standard uncertainty of the average: estimated spread of repeated averages under the independence assumption.

u_mean = s ÷ √n.name: Sample standard deviation (s)
u_mean = s ÷ √n.description: A calculated measure of how widely the readings scatter.

u_mean = s ÷ √n.name: n
u_mean = s ÷ √n.description: Number of readings in the sample.

u_total = √(u₁² + u₂²).name: u_total
u_total = √(u₁² + u₂²).description: Combined standard uncertainty from the listed independent contributions.

u_total = √(u₁² + u₂²).name: u₁
u_total = √(u₁² + u₂²).description: Standard uncertainty from the first independent source.

u_total = √(u₁² + u₂²).name: u₁, u₂
u_total = √(u₁² + u₂²).description: The standard uncertainties of the two input lengths.

f_sample = 1/Δt; f_sample > 2f_max.name: f_sample
f_sample = 1/Δt; f_sample > 2f_max.description: Sample rate: number of readings taken each second.

f_sample = 1/Δt; f_sample > 2f_max.name: Δ
f_sample = 1/Δt; f_sample > 2f_max.description: Change: the final value minus the starting value, unless this lesson states a different comparison.

f_sample = 1/Δt; f_sample > 2f_max.name: t
f_sample = 1/Δt; f_sample > 2f_max.description: Time; Δt is the gap between consecutive readings.

f_sample = 1/Δt; f_sample > 2f_max.name: f_max
f_sample = 1/Δt; f_sample > 2f_max.description: Highest signal frequency the measurement is intended to capture.

x = (y − b)/a.name: x
x = (y − b)/a.description: The corrected input quantity you want to estimate.

x = (y − b)/a.name: Gain, a
x = (y − b)/a.description: Change in instrument output per unit change in input.

u_cal = √(u_comparison² + u_reference²).name: u_cal
u_cal = √(u_comparison² + u_reference²).description: Combined standard uncertainty of the calibration result.

u_cal = √(u_comparison² + u_reference²).name: u_comparison
u_cal = √(u_comparison² + u_reference²).description: Standard uncertainty contributed by the instrument comparison.

u_cal = √(u_comparison² + u_reference²).name: u_reference
u_cal = √(u_comparison² + u_reference²).description: Standard uncertainty contributed by the reference standard.

s² = Σ(x_i − x̄)²/(n − 1).name: Standard deviation, s
s² = Σ(x_i − x̄)²/(n − 1).description: A measure of typical spread around the mean.

s² = Σ(x_i − x̄)²/(n − 1).name: Σ
s² = Σ(x_i − x̄)²/(n − 1).description: Add the indicated terms. The small labels tell you which terms to include.

s² = Σ(x_i − x̄)²/(n − 1).name: x_i
s² = Σ(x_i − x̄)²/(n − 1).description: Reading x with label i. The label counts the readings.

mean(x_i + b) = mean(x_i) + b.name: mean
mean(x_i + b) = mean(x_i) + b.description: Average: add the values and divide by how many there are, or use the stated probability weights.

mean(x_i + b) = mean(x_i) + b.name: x_i
mean(x_i + b) = mean(x_i) + b.description: Reading x with label i. The label counts the readings.

mean(x_i + b) = mean(x_i) + b.name: b
mean(x_i + b) = mean(x_i) + b.description: The shared additive offset in this model.

u_rounding = w/√12.name: u_rounding
u_rounding = w/√12.description: Standard uncertainty assigned to the rounding on the display.

u_rounding = w/√12.name: w
u_rounding = w/√12.description: Width of one display step in this rounding model.

u_y ≈ |dy/dx|u_x.name: u_y
u_y ≈ |dy/dx|u_x.description: Standard uncertainty of the result y.

u_y ≈ |dy/dx|u_x.name: d
u_y ≈ |dy/dx|u_x.description: A tiny change. In dA/dt, divide the tiny change in A by the tiny change in time to find its rate. In an integral, d names the small pieces being added.

u_y ≈ |dy/dx|u_x.name: y
u_y ≈ |dy/dx|u_x.description: The output quantity calculated or measured from x.

u_y ≈ |dy/dx|u_x.name: u_x
u_y ≈ |dy/dx|u_x.description: Standard uncertainty of the input x.

u²(x + y) = u_x² + u_y² + 2cov(x,y).name: u
u²(x + y) = u_x² + u_y² + 2cov(x,y).description: Standard uncertainty of the quantity in brackets. The squared sign makes it an uncertainty variance.

u²(x + y) = u_x² + u_y² + 2cov(x,y).name: x
u²(x + y) = u_x² + u_y² + 2cov(x,y).description: The first uncertain input being added.

u²(x + y) = u_x² + u_y² + 2cov(x,y).name: y
u²(x + y) = u_x² + u_y² + 2cov(x,y).description: The second uncertain input being added.

u²(x + y) = u_x² + u_y² + 2cov(x,y).name: u_x
u²(x + y) = u_x² + u_y² + 2cov(x,y).description: Standard uncertainty of the input x.

u²(x + y) = u_x² + u_y² + 2cov(x,y).name: u_y
u²(x + y) = u_x² + u_y² + 2cov(x,y).description: Standard uncertainty of the result y.

u²(x + y) = u_x² + u_y² + 2cov(x,y).name: cov
u²(x + y) = u_x² + u_y² + 2cov(x,y).description: Covariance: a measure of how two quantities change together.

S = Σ(y_i − ŷ_i)².name: S
S = Σ(y_i − ŷ_i)².description: Least-squares score: the sum of all squared prediction misses.

S = Σ(y_i − ŷ_i)².name: Σ
S = Σ(y_i − ŷ_i)².description: Add the indicated terms. The small labels tell you which terms to include.

S = Σ(y_i − ŷ_i)².name: y_i
S = Σ(y_i − ŷ_i)².description: Observed output value for reading i.

w_i = 1/u_i².name: w_i
w_i = 1/u_i².description: Weight assigned to reading i in the fit.

w_i = 1/u_i².name: u_i
w_i = 1/u_i².description: Standard uncertainty assigned to reading i.

χ²_red = [Σ((y_i − ŷ_i)/u_i)²]/(n − p).name: χ
χ²_red = [Σ((y_i − ŷ_i)/u_i)²]/(n − p).description: Chi, read “kai.” Here chi-squared measures how far the readings are from the model, compared with their uncertainties.

χ²_red = [Σ((y_i − ŷ_i)/u_i)²]/(n − p).name: Σ
χ²_red = [Σ((y_i − ŷ_i)/u_i)²]/(n − p).description: Add the indicated terms. The small labels tell you which terms to include.

χ²_red = [Σ((y_i − ŷ_i)/u_i)²]/(n − p).name: y_i
χ²_red = [Σ((y_i − ŷ_i)/u_i)²]/(n − p).description: Observed output value for reading i.

χ²_red = [Σ((y_i − ŷ_i)/u_i)²]/(n − p).name: ŷ_i
χ²_red = [Σ((y_i − ŷ_i)/u_i)²]/(n − p).description: Value predicted by the fitted model for reading i. The hat marks a prediction.

χ²_red = [Σ((y_i − ŷ_i)/u_i)²]/(n − p).name: u_i
χ²_red = [Σ((y_i − ŷ_i)/u_i)²]/(n − p).description: Standard uncertainty assigned to reading i.

χ²_red = [Σ((y_i − ŷ_i)/u_i)²]/(n − p).name: n
χ²_red = [Σ((y_i − ŷ_i)/u_i)²]/(n − p).description: Number of readings in the sample.

U = k u_c.name: Expanded uncertainty, U
U = k u_c.description: A stated multiple of combined standard uncertainty.

U = k u_c.name: Coverage factor, k
U = k u_c.description: The multiplier chosen for the intended coverage under the model.

U = k u_c.name: u_c
U = k u_c.description: Combined standard uncertainty, before multiplying by the coverage factor.
